subject: API admin key rotation & initial credential handoff — Pegasus Health
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anika Mueller <anika.mueller@pegasushealth.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff: initial API admin credentials + rotation window (Pegasus)

Hi Vivek / Karthik —

Putting you both in touch for the initial credentials and an admin key rotation plan for Pegasus Health. Pegasus is ready to accept the tenant and wants the admin API key seeded into their admin project so their SREs can validate requests and integrate with their decrypting KMS.

Quick context: Pegasus will run a short smoke test and then rotate the seeded admin key immediately after the first successful run. They also asked for a documented rotation window and service account mapping. I’ve attached our standard invite instructions and their role map from the pre-sales notes.

Attachments: redwood-invite-instructions.pdf, pegasus-role-mapping.xlsx

Ask: Can you confirm the following by EOD Monday (21 Jun):
- Which key we will seed (admin vs ops) and the TTL for the seeded token
- A recommended 1-hour rotation window (preferred local time slot for Pegasus ops)
- Any pre-rotation validations Pegasus needs to run

Anika — I looped Vivek (implementation lead) and Karthik (infra) to coordinate the key handoff and the rotation steps.

Thanks —
Monica
Customer Success | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

From: Anika Mueller <anika.mueller@pegasushealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Pegasus Health IT <it@pegasushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: initial API admin credentials + rotation window (Pegasus)

Thanks Monica — appreciate the intro. A few quick questions from our side before we lock a rotation window: 

1) Will the seeded credential be full "org-admin" scope or a scoped admin key limited to the new project? We prefer scoped keys for auditability unless you recommend seeding full admin for the initial smoke test.
2) What is the process for JWT/API key exchange? Do we receive a one-time plaintext token via the console link or a signed download?
3) Can the rotation be scheduled in our TZ (Eastern) between 10:00–11:00 AM ET on Wednesday 24 Jun? That works best for our on-call team.

Also — we need any pre-rotation validation steps documented (simple curl checks we can run) and a rollback procedure in case the rotation causes unexpected 401s for our background workers.

—Anika
Anika Mueller
Senior Systems Engineer, Pegasus Health
anika.mueller@pegasushealth.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anika Mueller <anika.mueller@pegasushealth.com>, Pegasus Health IT <it@pegasushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: initial API admin credentials + rotation window (Pegasus)

On Mon, 22 Jun 2026 at 08:04 AM Anika Mueller <anika.mueller@pegasushealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks Monica — appreciate the intro. A few quick questions from our side before we lock a rotation window: 
> 
> 1) Will the seeded credential be full "org-admin" scope or a scoped admin key limited to the new project? We prefer scoped keys for auditability unless you recommend seeding full admin for the initial smoke test.
> 2) What is the process for JWT/API key exchange? Do we receive a one-time plaintext token via the console link or a signed download?
> 3) Can the rotation be scheduled in our TZ (Eastern) between 10:00–11:00 AM ET on Wednesday 24 Jun? That works best for our on-call team.

Thanks for the questions — answering inline and proposing a plan: 

1) Recommendation: seed a scoped admin key bound to Pegasus' initial project (least privilege) with the ability to escalate if the smoke test needs broader access. We'll keep an org-admin key offline for emergencies only.

2) Exchange process: we will generate the seeded key in the private control plane and deliver a one-time plaintext token via the console-signed download (link will be time-limited). Pegasus should store it in their vault (we recommend the HSM/KMS path in their role map). After the rotation event we will invalidate the seeded token.

3) Rotation window: Wednesday 24 Jun 2026, 10:00–11:00 AM ET is fine. We'll schedule the rotation at 10:15 AM ET to allow a short warmup. Karthik — action items below.

Action items (owners):
- Karthik: generate scoped admin key in the private control plane, attach to Pegasus project, and create the time-limited console download link (due Wed 24 Jun 08:00 AM ET). (attachment: pegasus-role-mapping.xlsx)
- Pegasus (Anika / IT): retrieve the one-time token, store in your vault, and run pre-rotation smoke tests (see curl checks in the attached invite instructions). Please report any 401s immediately to this thread.
- Monica: confirm billing + access notes have been completed and provide the HubSpot record if needed.

Pre-rotation checks (basic):
- curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health -> 200 OK
- ping sample generate endpoint with small payload -> 200 and token-identified logs appear in our console

Rollback plan: we will temporarily re-seed a short-lived ops token if the rotation fails; we will not revert model state. Karthik, please prepare the ops token (30m TTL) as emergency backstop.

I will join the rotation call at 10:05 AM ET to monitor logs and verify successful token invalidation.

-Vivek
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Mueller <anika.mueller@pegasushealth.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Pegasus Health IT <it@pegasushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Handoff: initial API admin credentials + rotation window (Pegasus)

Forwarding confirmation — plan and timeline below.

We will:
- Generate a scoped admin key bound to project "pegasus-prod-staging" and create the console time-limited download link.
- Seed an emergency ops token (30m TTL) and keep it offline until the rotation event.
- Provide step-by-step curl checks in the console download and copy them to the shared Drive folder.

Schedule:
- Wed 24 Jun 2026, 08:00 AM ET: console link created and smoke-check instructions uploaded to Drive (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bExampleSharedDrive)
- Wed 24 Jun 2026, 10:15 AM ET: rotation execution (Vivek monitoring, Karthik executing)
- Wed 24 Jun 2026, 10:30–11:00 AM ET: post-rotation verification window (Pegasus runs full background worker checks)

Attachments: redwood-invite-instructions.pdf, pegasus-role-mapping.xlsx

Anika — please confirm you have the weekend to validate the pre-rotation smoke tests; otherwise we'll move the window. If everything looks good we'll mark this complete after the 11:00 AM verification window.

Thanks,
Karthik
Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
